Method of Attack: Disabling Microsoft Defender using the 'DisableAntiSpyware' Registry value to infiltrate Windows computers
Exploiting a brief lapse in Tamper Protection to disable Microsoft Defender after a reboot
Impacted Systems: Windows 10 devices with Microsoft Defender Antivirus
Attack Vector: Malware rebooting the computer to disable Defender temporarily
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of 'DisableAntiSpyware' Registry value set to 1 under HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender
